title: Add patch version changeset
body:
Adds a patch changeset to bump all packages in the fixed versioning group from `3.0.5` → `3.0.6`.

- Changeset targets `@objectstack/spec` with `patch` bump type, which propagates to all 21 packages in the fixed group
